name: @pbgo/pipeline
description: `pnpm add-game "<name>"`: the terminal pipeline that takes a game from its name to the platform's catalog, one headless Claude Code step at a time (`claude -p`, the owner's login) with a gate in the terminal after each. `bin/` holds the entries Node runs (type stripping), `src/` the parts (the state of a game, the steps, the call and its stream, the gates, the policy that is the allowlist of a headless step, the Linear bookkeeping), `hook/` the PreToolUse hook that enforces the policy.
